name: First Street Towers Central (FSTC)

dimensions.height_uncertainty: GIS Extrution=46 has undocumented units; modeled floor-to-floor and roof heights are estimates, not surveyed values.

footprint_comparison.gis_outline: Official GIS outline used for structural walls. Projected area ~1481 m2; bounds recorded above.

architecture_evidence.supports: Residential use, cluster rooms, central lounge/dinette and community kitchen. Bedrooms reported as 9 ft 8 in by 13 ft 9 in.
Red-brown brick, pale stone entrance surround, arched entrance canopy and sign.
Building identity and address, 1250 First Street.

model_notes: Portable procedural brick/stone/glass materials; no external texture dependency.
Main entrance is placed on the south-facing First Street side, based on the published address and 2019 photo; exact GIS door position is not provided and remains estimated.
Seven floors are source supported. Window spacing, wall detailing, parapet, story height and roof treatment are visual estimates.
Interior is a schematic illustration of documented room clusters and shared lounge/dinette, not an architectural plan.
Decorative facades/interior components are consolidated in the named object; expected scene and collection names preserved.
